klipler.istem: Slow cinematic push-in on the glossy wet salamander face, light glints slide across the smooth black skin, the salamander blinks once slowly. The salamander keeps exactly two eyes and the same shape. 3D animation style preserved.

The salamander walks slowly forward across the wet leaves, light rain falls, mist drifts between the trees. Static camera, the salamander stays small in the frame and keeps the same shape. 3D animation style preserved.

Slow macro camera glide along the salamander's back, small droplets on the smooth skin swell slightly and glisten, the body breathes gently. The salamander keeps the same shape. 3D animation style preserved.
The two hands rub soap together under the running tap, foam builds up and water rinses it away. Static camera. Hands keep the same number of fingers. 3D animation style preserved.
